runs.t: Clean Architecture organizes code around business policies that do not depend on frameworks, databases, or UI details. Dependencies generally point inward toward stable domain concepts and use cases.

Distinguish entities/domain rules, application use cases, interface adapters, and external infrastructure. Define ports for effects, then supply adapters; domain decisions remain testable without starting a server or connecting a database.

In a hotel booking flow, the use case checks availability, applies cancellation policy, and requests persistence through a repository port. Express controllers translate HTTP input, while MongoDB adapters implement storage details.

Do not create four layers around a simple CRUD form by default. Abstract business capabilities, not every library function; ensure error, transaction and authorization behavior is consistent across the boundaries.
